is_delete = 0 and `status` = 1

order by create_time desc limit #{limit}, #{size}
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, "%Y-%m-%d") AS date, COUNT(*) AS count FROM t_article GROUP BY date ORDER BY date DESC
SELECT id AS articleId, article_title AS articleTitle, views, is_top AS isTop, is_recommend AS isRecommend, create_time AS createTime FROM t_article WHERE is_delete = 0 AND `status` = 1

AND is_recommend = 1 LIMIT 5

SELECT a.id, article_cover, article_title, a.create_time, c.id AS category_id, c.category_name, t.id AS tag_id, tag_name FROM ( SELECT id, category_id, article_cover, article_title, create_time FROM t_article WHERE is_delete = 0 AND `status` = 1
AND category_id = #{condition.categoryId}
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t_article_tag filter_tat WHERE filter_tat.article_id = t_article.id AND filter_tat.tag_id = #{condition.tagId})
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t_category c WHERE c.id = t_article.category_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t_article_tag tat INNER JOIN t_tag t ON t.id = tat.tag_id WHERE tat.article_id = t_article.id) ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit}, #{size} ) a INNER JOIN t_category c ON a.category_id = c.id INNER JOIN t_article_tag tat ON a.id = tat.article_id INNER JOIN t_tag t ON tat.tag_id = t.id ORDER BY a.id DESC
